title: [29.X]-Source Currency Amount calculation causes discrepancies with Foreign Currency G/L Entries whit Reversal Charge VAT.
summary: Fixed how Gen. Jnl.-Post Line calculates source currency amounts, so G/L entries in a foreign currency with reverse charge VAT no longer show discrepancies.
key_points: Corrected source currency amount calculation in codeunit 12 Gen. Jnl.-Post Line
Codeunit changed in W1 and the APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NA, NO and RU layers
Tests added to ERM Source Currency in W1, CZ, ES, IT and RU
